what_a_verdict_means.ACCEPT: the redraft or delta does what the ruled judgment asked, and may ship in that form once he gives his word and its carries are met
what_a_verdict_means.AMEND: the disposition stands, but a named defect is owed a correction, judged by a seat that did not draft it
what_a_verdict_means.REJECT: the disposition is wrong; it returns to a drafting seat
what_a_verdict_means.CONFIRM: the change to the gate is right as made
what_a_verdict_means.CORRECT: the change to the gate is wrong, and what is owed is named
what_a_verdict_means.STANDS: the knocked-on HOLDS is unaffected by the new (b)s and (d)s; its R1 verdict stands and its card may ship once his word and its carries allow
what_a_verdict_means.REOPENS: a new (b) or (d) records the answer the HOLDS relies on as flawed or as ending at bedrock; the HOLDS is held back, and the lean is for his re-ruling
what_a_verdict_means.finding: no verdict: a matter outside any one row, with its recommendation and whose it is
